entity.description: One row per fresh read-only query an agent sent (or tried to send) to a tenant's system through Darpan's stored connection: who, which system and connection, what was asked, and how it ended. Written in its own transaction, so a failed query still leaves its row.

field.name: companyUserGroupId
field.description: The tenant the query ran for.

field.name: userId
field.description: The person whose agent sent it.

field.name: systemEnumId
field.description: The system queried (NetSuite, HotWax OMS or Shopify).

field.name: queryHash
field.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the full query text.

field.name: queryText
field.description: The first 2,000 characters of the query.

field.name: outcome
field.description: OK, REFUSED, THROTTLED, ERROR or TIMEOUT.
